title: Long-distance healing in Australia over the phone

tellings.quote: I've seen it too many times. I've seen it happen in Australia >> over the phone >> long distance.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, the subject of an episode about why NASA studies him and his claim to draw UFOs, says he has seen healing happen at a distance, with someone in Australia, over the phone. He tells Michels this as something he saw himself, and says he has seen it "too many times" to doubt it. He gives no names or details. If true, it would mean healing can work across an ocean with no one in the room.
